public_claim_boundary: This runbook is not release-candidate paper readiness evidence. It defines the final report and IEEE scaffold refresh procedure, but paper_and_artifact_readiness remains incomplete until upstream review and infrastructure gates pass and docs/v1-paper-readiness.json is refreshed with release-candidate evidence.
required_inputs: passed hosted or containerized release-candidate smoke
refresh_steps: separate frozen v0.0 evidence from current v1-prep evidence
state true v1 claims only after release gates pass
incorporate hosted and protected execution findings
verify current stale and legacy labels
acceptance_checks: benchmark source sha matches release evidence
publication_rules: public paper text contains redacted or aggregate private evidence only
private task bodies are never published
nonpublic task identifiers are never published
local absolute paths are never published
v1-prep and v1-ready claims are not conflated
release_notes: A passing runbook check only proves that the final paper refresh procedure is specified.
The paper gate requires docs/v1-paper-readiness.json with evidence_scope=release_candidate.
The paper gate also requires live upstream review and infrastructure gates to pass.
